skills.name: Transmutation
skills.unlock: Requires Alchemy Lv 15 (page Requirements field). Page states: "After reaching Alchemy Lv 15 and unlocking Transmutation, the "Element Transmute" square on your equipment window will no longer be grayed out."
skills.recipes_or_nodes: Rewrites a weapon's element. Cost: alchemy matter matching the weapon's tier, the essence matching the chosen element and tier, and Soul Crystals. Every echo already on the weapon raises the whole cost by 30%. Dark items cannot be transmuted.
skills.locations: Via the "Element Transmute" button on the equipment window.
skills.wiki_summary: Rewrite a weapon's element. Slot a weapon, pick a new element, and pay the alchemy matter matching the weapon's tier, the essence matching your chosen element and tier, and Soul Crystals. Every echo already on the weapon raises the whole cost by 30%. Dark items cannot be transmuted.
wiki_tips: We recommend having a full understanding of Elements and making Transmutation something you do before applying any Souls to an item. It will save you some materials in the long run!
skills.notes: Page gives example: Repressive Sword is a Tier 9 weapon (T9).
